displayIdentity.body: Changed plans are defended through sincerity and promise. For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you. who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.
